spec_refs.quote: At 2102, example method 2100 includes receiving, by a machine-learned agent system, a query associated with a user.
Input interface(s) 102 can receive inputs (e.g., from a user). Query 104 can be based on data from input interfaces 102.

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 1 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

spec_refs.quote: At 2104, example method 2100 includes accessing, by the machine-learned agent system, memory data from an interaction memory datastore associated with the user.
Machine-learned agent system 100 can obtain memory data 114 based on memory response 112

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 1 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

spec_refs.quote: the interaction memory datastore includes one or more memory objects that were generated based on one or more prior interactions between the machine-learned agent system and the user
Interaction memory datastore 110 can contain stored contextual information catalogued and stored over prior interactions with the user.

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 2 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

items.search_note: 청구항은 `comprises`, 명세서 대응 문언은 `includes` 로 어형만 다르고 조응은 동일하다(원천 불일치가 아니라 청구항/요약 간 통상적 어형 차이). FIG-2 는 도면부호를 갖는 블록도이며 메모리 객체·값·메타데이터 부호(202/204/206)를 등재했다.

spec_refs.quote: At 2106, example method 2100 includes inputting, by the machine-learned agent system and to a machine-learned sequence processing model, an input data structure based on the query and the memory
Input data structure 116 can include memory data 114. Input data structure 116 can include data based on query 104

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 1 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

spec_refs.quote: At 2108, example method 2100 includes generating, by the machine-learned agent system and based on processing the input data structure using the machine-learned sequence processing model, an output.
Machine-learned model system 118 can process input data structure 116 to generate output data structure 120.

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 1 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

items.search_note: 「machine-learned sequence processing model」 자체의 구조는 FIG-13(sequence processing model(s) 4)에 별도로 그려지나, 청구항 e4 의 실행 주체 조응은 FIG-1 의 118/116/120 경로가 최소 단위여서 그것을 등재했다.

spec_refs.quote: At 2110, example method 2100 includes outputting, by the machine-learned agent system, and based on the output, a response to the query.
Machine-learned agent system 100 can output response 122 based on output data structure 120.

figure_refs.caption_quote: Figure 1 is a block diagram that illustrates aspects of a machine-learned agent system according to example implementations of aspects of the present disclosure.

review_requests.reason: e4·e5 가 모두 FIG-1 의 116→118→120 경로 하나에 접지된다 — 「sequence processing model」의 도면 조응을 FIG-13(부호 4·5·6·7)으로 옮겨야 하는지, 아니면 시스템 수준 부호 118 로 두는 것이 맞는지 Owner 판단이 필요하다. [0109]의 '118 can execute … one or more machine-learned model(s) 1' 와 [0329]의 sequence processing model(s) 4 정의를 대조하면 판가름난다.
